payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes expected turns for improved bogosort on derangements via 1D DP recurrence: ans[n] from ans[n-1], term[n] (derangement-related counts), and cumulative sums, using precomputed factorials.
payload.rationale: DP state is single dimension n (length of unsorted segment). Recurrence uses ans[n-1] and combinatorial term[n] without multidimensional state; thus dp_1d_state fits best.
